You press your hand over the wound and feel the escaping blood slow beneath a faint red glow.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one adjacent willing living creature, immediately before its Bleeding damage at turn end.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires one free hand; grants no item.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Reduce temporary Bleeding by 2, minimum 0, then resolve its remaining Bleeding and normal decay. Starred contributions remain. This restores no HP and does not treat the wound that caused it.
